title: umahorses
description: Turns every horse into an Uma Musume. Faster? No. Cuter? Absolutely.
body:
**This resource pack is in very early development.** 
For now, it's essentially a rework/enhancement of the [Umamusume Resource Pack](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/umamusume-resource-pack/). In the future, I plan to replace the sounds and create proper animations.

The resource pack also requires [EMF (Entity Model Features)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features/) and [ETF (Entity Texture Features)](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures/), or alternatively Callo-OptiFine.
